# Best noise-cancelling headphones under $100

**Best overall: Soundcore Space One, about $80 with a code**
- Best Products' top pick under $100. It has adaptive ANC, a 55-hour battery, rotating ear cups and a good app with EQ. It's a bit heavy.
- Dealectric lists it at $99.99, or $80 with code **AFSC20** (tested in the cart 2026-10-22, so the store's checkout has the final word).
- [Buy the Soundcore Space One](https://dealectric.com/go/soundcore-space-one). This is an affiliate link, so Dealectric earns a commission at no cost to you.
- Source: https://www.bestproducts.com/tech/gadgets/g61501080/cheap-noise-canceling-headphones-under-100/

**Strongest noise cancelling: Soundcore Space Q45, about $99**
- RTINGS' best budget pick. It has excellent noise isolation, including engine rumble and office chatter, and a hard case. Battery is about 28 hours in RTINGS' testing, though CartIQ claims more. I'd trust the lab number.
- Some owners report the headband cracking, so handle it gently.
- Sources: https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/budget-noise-cancelling-headphones and https://www.cartiq.net/us/electronics/best-noise-cancelling-headphones-under-100/. Both pages have retailer price links.

**Cheaper alternatives**
- **Soundcore Life Q30:** RTINGS says it has the best ANC among under-$100 over-ears. It lasts about 44 hours and is comfortable, but leaks sound. See https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/over-ear-headphones-under-100.
- **Soundcore Life Q20 (2024):** Nearly matches the Q45's noise isolation for less money, with 49 hours of battery. The build feels hollow and the earpads can flake. See https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/budget-noise-cancelling-headphones.
- **Edifier W820NB Plus, about $79:** 49-hour battery, LDAC and plush earcups, but no case (CartIQ).
- **1MORE SonoFlow SE, about $65:** 70-hour battery, but weaker ANC (CartIQ). Also see https://www.cartiq.net/us/electronics/best-noise-cancelling-headphones-under-100/.
- **Edifier Atom Max, about $45:** Great value, with ANC up to 44 dB, but no headphone jack (Best Products).

**Other options**
- **Sony WH-CH720N, about $99:** Very light at 192 g and well regarded for ANC, but it has no LDAC (CartIQ).
- **JBL Tune 760NC, about $79:** Bass-heavy with a good mic, but RTINGS calls its ANC mediocre.

**My pick:** The Soundcore Space One at about $80 is the best mix of ANC, battery and price. If noise blocking matters most and you can spend about $99, get the Space Q45. Prices change often, so check the final price at checkout.
